scope: Only these three explicitly reviewed current script versions supplement historical mapping evidence. Original mapping hashes remain unchanged. No arbitrary new source version is accepted.
audit_findings: equip_armor still requires an existing owned ARMOR_ITEMS key and equips the catalog part_key; equip_armor_set still uses the unchanged Catalog item_key(part,set_id) for all four original parts.
get_bag_capacity still reads the independently equipped bag and catalog bag_slots, clamped to LOADOUT_MAX_SLOTS; no armor ability or concept stat proposal is activated by these visual routes.

Player visual IDs are read from equipped head/body/arms/legs catalog items and mapped to head/body/hand/foot mesh names. Backpack visual_id comes from the independently equipped bag and attaches to fly_bag.

ArmorVisuals uses exact approved scene routes for IDs0-5, preserves existing Thunder6 and Cygni11 routes, and keeps the generic visual_id fallback. Replacements preserve original part node names, mesh Skin and transform for animation and mixed equipment.

Re-audited the three current scripts after upstream difficulty/weapon updates and the bow look_at roll correction. GameState armor equip/bag functions and ArmorVisuals scene/part routes remain byte-exact. The backpack function only switches to per-surface restore_backpack_materials; bag visual_id, fly_bag attachment and transforms remain unchanged. The bow roll affects only arrow weapon alignment, outside armor/backpack mapping. Historical mapping evidence and the other seven audited function hashes remain unchanged. The procedural scabbard refresh call is also removed; armor/backpack mapping functions are unchanged.
